beats.text: Five books that explain human nature better than any textbook.
One. Crime and Punishment — Dostoevsky maps guilt, pride, and the stories we tell to excuse ourselves.
Two. The Prince — Machiavelli, on how people really chase and keep power.
Three. Pride and Prejudice — Austen, a masterclass in how we misjudge each other.
Four. Heart of Darkness — Conrad, on how thin the civilised veneer really is.
Five. The Picture of Dorian Gray — Wilde, on vanity, conscience, and the masks we wear.
Fiction is a laboratory for people. Full retellings of each are on the channel.
